result.summary: The main layout is generally intact, but horizontally scrolling content is visibly cut off at the right edge and the lower restaurant card is obscured by the persistent bottom navigation.

issues.description: The third item in the “Fastest near you” carousel is clipped by the right edge, including its restaurant name (“Smash Bros Bu…”), with no clear trailing spacing or affordance that the row can be scrolled horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Add right-side carousel padding and a visible partial-card treatment that does not cut off key text, or ensure titles truncate cleanly with an ellipsis. Consider a scroll indicator or clearer horizontal-scroll cue.

issues.description: The next “Popular right now” restaurant card continues underneath the fixed bottom navigation, so a substantial portion of the card is hidden at the bottom of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards can be fully viewed above the bottom navigation.
